name: MMM Labs
description: MMMLabs connects Claude to the MMMLabs marketing mix modeling platform. Use natural language to explore projects and datasets, search the Knowledge Center, check model readiness, run models (OLS, Robyn, PyMC, Meridian, and others per role), and analyze ROI, contributions, response curves, and scenarios. OAuth 2.1 with PKCE via your MMMLabs login. Destructive actions require explicit approval via Confirm delete or cancel. Requires an active MMMLabs organization account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MMM Labs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MMM Labs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mmmlabs.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MMM Labs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MMM Labs lists 16 MCP tools, including confirm_destructive_action, discover_tools, get_model_status, get_output_mode, get_project, get_user_info, get_workspace_context, list_accounts, list_projects, run_data_action, run_mmm_workflow, and run_model_action.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MMM Labs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MMM Labs in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does MMM Labs MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MMM Labs requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MMM Labs is developed by ScanmarQED. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
